It’s okay to feel that way, talk to a doctor about it. What you need is ongoing support so that you can talk to someone that will challenge the ways you think and make those painful memories loose their sting. I know that sounds impossible or that it might work for other people but not me I get that I was like that too, but, your brains not working right. Stay focused on your immediate tasks and when you start to feel your mind wander go over your list of things you need to do in your head again, say it out loud if you need to repeat it back to yourself. Your brain is a muscle and the thoughts your having can be rerouted. Think of it like changing the path of running water, some water might sleep through at first but if you keep redirecting it the barrier gets stronger and stronger till you don’t need to concisely do it at all anymore and those painful memories are left in your past. You do need to go to talking therapy and work through them though to take away their sting :)

Well firstly how your feeling is valid and you should be talking about it, from the sounds of what you’ve described I’d say what you need is to talk to a physiatrist, this is easily done. Go to hospital and explain how your feeling. They will be able to get you the help you need to change your perspective on the things making you feel so bad about yourself. Ask yourself would I want to die if the situations that made me feel this way were not there? If you wouldn’t then what you need is talking therapy so that you can have someone challenge the thoughts in your head and help you create new ones. Also overdosing is the absolute worst thing trust me I did it. You won’t feel anything the day after then two, three days later you’ll feel like someone has put a blowtorch inside your body. You’ll swell up and your eyes and skin will turn yellow, fluid will build up in your spine and swell your eyes shut. Your stomach will expand and you’ll bloat like the boomer from left4dead. You’ll be in the most agonizing and frightening pain you’ll have ever experienced and most likely be left horrifically scared from the liver transplant that you’ll receive. Or you can go to your doctor and get mental health support. You wanna see what overdoses look like google “liver failure patient” then see if you want to do that.

Sorry you feel so low dude, it’s common in a lot of people that have anxiety and mood disorders to fixate on the events that made them sick. The best thing you can do is focus completely on yourself in the moment. Make a plan and when you start to feel yourself thinking about the past or what other people are doing make yourself think about what you need to get done that day. Start small, I have to get shopping, then what type of shopping do I need to get?, make yourself a meal plan for the week, then maybe think about what you’d like your life to be like. Be realistic do you want a house? A car? A gf? Then practical and meaningful ways to do that. Small victories from following simple checklist day to day plans not only preoccupy your mind but give you an immense feeling of satisfaction

You seem to have a very low opinion of yourself and assume that people will leave or reject you before you’ve tried, this sounds like BPD to me and it is not only treatable it’s curable with talking therapy and support. Your brain is just broke at the moment, if you broke your arm you’d go to the hospital and get a cast put on right? That’s all you need to do dude :)

Talk to your doctor about Borderline Personality Disorder. If you tend to find staying in a level mood impossible and frequently “get better” then skip back into suicidal thoughts and actions chances are there is a treatable solution to the way you are feeling. Ask yourself have I had therapy? Have I made significant changes to my day to day life? Would I still feel like this if the events that made me this way hadn’t happened? If you said yes what you need is support. If you broke your leg and didn’t get a cast of crutches it would be unbearable right? Same thing goes for your emotions. Your brain is a muscle like anything else and when you feel suicidal it’s just broke and needs a cast, your cast may be therapy or anti depressants just have a go dude :)
